implementation.boundary: Complete request and response parsing; chained writes/readbacks share a finite operation budget. No automatic write retries.
implementation.lifecycle: Export, interview, retention and resume polling propagate cancellation and suppress late side effects. Other inspected reads retain existing stale-result fences and finite deadlines.
